resultJson.title: Add Option/Either conversion sample
resultJson.body:
Adds `eitherocoption/EitherOption.scala`, a sample showing how to convert between `Option` and `Either` in both directions (`toRight`, `toOption`, `toLeft`, `left.toOption`).

It includes a small `ParseError` enum and a `parseInt` example that keeps the failure reason, plus an `eitherOptionDemo` main that prints the results.

The diff also includes an `.orca/runs/*.progress.json` progress log file.
